# kion_billing_source_azure (Resource)

Manages an Azure billing source (CSP, EA or MCA) in Kion.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kion_billing_source_azure" "example" {
  # Required
  account_type_id    = 1
  billing_start_date = "example"
  name               = "example"

  # Optional
  # account_creation                           = false
  # app_id                                     = "example"
  # azure_csp_id                               = 1
  # client_secret                              = "example"
  # customer_id                                = "example"
  # domain                                     = "example"
  # focus_storage_container                    = "example"
  # focus_storage_prefix                       = "example"
  # focus_storage_primary_endpoint             = "example"
  # primary_management_group_azure_id          = "example"
  # resource_group_creation                    = false
  # skip_validation                            = false
  # storage_container                          = "example"
  # storage_prefix                             = "example"
  # storage_primary_endpoint                   = "example"
  # subscription_creation                      = false
  # tenant_level_charge_attribution_account_id = 1
  # use_focus_reports                          = false
  # use_proprietary_reports                    = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_type_id` (Number) Kion account type of the billing source: 3 Azure CSP, 6 Azure EA, 16 Azure MCA, or their Government and Secret variants.
- `billing_start_date` (String) First month Kion reads billing data for, as YYYY-MM.
- `name` (String) Name of the billing source.

### Optional

- `account_creation` (Boolean) Whether accounts can be created under this billing source.
- `app_id` (String) Application (client) ID of the Azure service principal.
- `azure_csp_id` (Number) ID of the parent Azure CSP record
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Client secret of the Azure service principal. Kion never returns it, so it is not read back: a change made outside Terraform is not detected.
- `customer_id` (String) The Azure customer or enrollment id.
- `domain` (String) Azure AD tenant domain.
- `focus_storage_container` (String) Storage container holding the FOCUS export.
- `focus_storage_prefix` (String) Path prefix of the FOCUS export in the container.
- `focus_storage_primary_endpoint` (String) Primary blob endpoint of the FOCUS export storage account.
- `primary_management_group_azure_id` (String) Azure id of the management group new subscriptions are placed under.
- `resource_group_creation` (Boolean) Whether Kion may create resource groups under this billing source.
- `skip_validation` (Boolean) Create or update without first testing the Azure credentials and storage access. Kion still stores the values as given.
- `storage_container` (String) Storage container holding the billing export.
- `storage_prefix` (String) Path prefix of the billing export in the container.
- `storage_primary_endpoint` (String) Primary blob endpoint of the billing export storage account.
- `subscription_creation` (Boolean) Whether Kion may create subscriptions under this billing source.
- `tenant_level_charge_attribution_account_id` (Number) ID of the account tenant-level charges are attributed to.
- `use_focus_reports` (Boolean) Whether Kion reads the FOCUS export.
- `use_proprietary_reports` (Boolean) Whether Kion reads the Azure cost export.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
